# stet source

This runtime is built from stet v0.8.1 at commit `a61c70796f25e0d0a8f5eaa04992cb7cd222aa07`.

- Source archive: https://github.com/AndyCappDev/stet/archive/refs/tags/v0.8.1.tar.gz
- SHA-256: `78a1140a4fad3862325f04402e746f590b4fb82664127e9416d97a2052be0510`
- Build recipe: `tools/stet-wasm-build/build.sh`
- Build: default `stet-wasm` features, which include PS/EPS rendering and exclude the optional PDF reader API.

The runtime is distributed under Apache-2.0 OR MIT. The unmodified upstream source and project-maintained build recipe are sufficient to reproduce the JavaScript glue and WebAssembly binary.
